title: Full Stack .Net Developer
description:
Position Overview The Senior Full-Stack Developer will design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications software platforms, with a primary focus on TrackerCheck and related APIs, admin web, and mobile clients. This role requires expertise across TypeScript, React, Node.js/Express, and C#/.NET, working with MySQL and AWS as the primary data and cloud platforms. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions that serve major global energy companies. Reporting to the Director of Development, the Senior Full-Stack Developer will work on both greenfield projects and enhancements to existing platforms, contributing to all phases of the software development lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain full-stack web applications using TypeScript, React (react-admin), Node.js/Express, and C#/ASP.NET Core Build and optimize RESTful APIs using Express.js and ASP.NET Core for enterprise-scale, multi-tenant applications Develop responsive, intuitive user interfaces using React, react-admin, and modern frontend libraries (MUI, enterprise data grids) Design and implement database schemas, queries, migrations, and optimizations for MySQL using Sequelize and/or Entity Framework Implement authentication and authorization using JWT, OAuth, AWS Cognito, and RBAC Integrate applications with AWS services including Lambda, S3, SQS, Cognito, and related container/ECS workloads Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code (Jest, Cypress) Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architecture decisions Troubleshoot and resolve production issues across the full technology stack Contribute to API documentation and maintain technical documentation Job Requirements Required 8+ years of professional full-stack development experience TypeScript strong proficiency across backend and frontend Node.js / Express — production REST APIs, middleware, services, and background workers React — complex SPA development; react-admin (or equivalent admin/RBAC data-grid UIs) strongly preferred Proven experience building and deploying production REST APIs, with a deep understanding of architecture and design patterns MySQL — schema design, queries, and migrations; Sequelize required (or equivalent ORM with willingness to use Sequelize) C# and ASP.NET Core — production API development; Entity Framework preferred AWS — practical experience with Lambda, S3, SQS, and Cognito; Docker and containerized deployments Authentication and security — JWT, OAuth, Cognito, RBAC, and secure coding practices Git, code review, CI, and the ability to troubleshoot production issues across the stack Problem-solving mindset, excellent communication, ability to work collaboratively, self-motivated with strong attention to detail and quality Preferred React Native (React Native CLI / EAS) for iOS and Android MUI, AG Grid, or similar enterprise grid/form libraries ASP.NET Core Identity and dependency injection patterns used in .NET services Optional Oracle Database (SQL, drivers, dual-dialect schema work alongside MySQL) Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) — Functions, Object Storage, Queues, identity, and Autonomous Database. Experience is a plus; AWS remains the primary cloud Education Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent professional qualification)

Key Skills: .Net Core,Full Stack,Core,.Net,C#,Development,React.js,Stack
